topic: View and Edit Processed Salaries (Salary Summary Month Wise)
summary: This feature allows users to view the processed salaries for a specific month for all or selected employees and make individual adjustments to earning or deduction amounts.
steps: Select the "Year" and "Month" for which you want to view salaries.
Click "Go". (Leaving other fields blank will show all employees).
Review the list of employees with their IDs, names, departments, designations, payable days, gross salary, deduction amount, and paid salary.
To make changes for a specific employee, click the "View" option corresponding to their entry.
The employee's complete salary structure will open.
To modify an existing head, change the amount directly.
To add a new earning or deduction head, click "Add", select the head, and enter the amount (e.g., adding "Advance Recovery" deduction).
After making changes, enter "Remarks" explaining the modification (e.g., "Advance Recovery added").
Click "Save". A pop-up will confirm that the changes have been saved.
business_rules: Any changes made to an employee's processed salary must be accompanied by remarks to be saved and reflected.
important_notes: This is the primary place to make ad-hoc changes to an employee's salary for a specific month after it has been processed.
Changes made here only affect the current month's processed salary, not the underlying salary template (contract).
